events.title: Globe Theatre burns down during Henry VIII
events.description: A cannon fired for a stage effect set the thatched roof alight, and Shakespeare's playhouse burned to the ground within an hour. No one was killed, and it was rebuilt the next year.
events.html: A cannon fired for a stage effect set the thatched roof alight, and Shakespeare's playhouse burned to the ground within an hour. No one was killed, and it was rebuilt the next year.

events.title: Spanish found Mission San Francisco de Asís
events.description: Franciscan friars celebrated the first Mass at the mission later known as Mission Dolores, as Spain expanded northward in California. The settlement grew into San Francisco.
events.html: Franciscan friars celebrated the first Mass at the mission later known as Mission Dolores, as Spain expanded northward in California. The settlement grew into San Francisco.

events.title: The Daily Telegraph is first published
events.description: The Daily Telegraph and Courier appeared in London. Under new owners it soon became a penny paper and for a time had the largest circulation in the world.
events.html: The Daily Telegraph and Courier appeared in London. Under new owners it soon became a penny paper and for a time had the largest circulation in the world.

events.title: Roger Casement is sentenced to death for treason
events.description: The Irish nationalist and former British diplomat was condemned for seeking German help for the Easter Rising. Despite pleas for clemency he was hanged in August.

events.title: Sampoong Department Store collapses in Seoul
events.description: The five-storey store fell in seconds, killing 502 people. Investigators found illegal alterations and ignored warnings, prompting reforms of South Korean building safety.
